'''Chrellis Base''' was the [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command]] base on the [[Planetoid/Legends|planetoid]] [[Chrellis]], and it was the first High Command base established by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. It was abandoned when the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], in an unfortunate coincidence, moved one of its [[Sector fleet/Legends|Sector Fleets]] close to the area.
